withdrawal_operator.source_history_note: Vandier's Latin rendering is more cognitive/literal ('did not know...'), whereas Leitz and Quack/Jørgensen render the construction modally as inability to withdraw. TLA independently attests rḫ with infinitive as 'be able to do', supporting the modal reading.
withdrawal_operator.diplomatic_boundary: The primary facsimile signs for the entire withdrawal clause have not yet been mapped one-by-one to Unicode/Gardiner codes; exact diplomatic sign-string remains pending.

retention_operator.vandier_index_lane: mḥ: s'emparer de (m); also separate dictionary senses imprison/envelop and fill
retention_operator.derchain_leitz_lane: mḥ: fill; contextually swell/expand; preferred over šd 'take out/remove' for this locus
retention_operator.minimum_mechanical_model: PHALLUS IN VULVA-VAGINA COMPLEX -> FILLING/SWELLING_OR_RETENTION CONDITION -> WITHDRAWAL IMPOSSIBLE

kat_ontology_revision.medical_control: Modern medical-text commentary distinguishes kꜣ.t as the external female genital region while jd.t denotes internal genitalia; a recent synthesis describes kꜣ.t as a vulva-vagina complex that can include the vagina depending on context.
kat_ontology_revision.implication_for_pBrooklyn_metal_kat: Do not assume a tubular internal sheath. The metal kꜣ.t may model external female genital anatomy, a combined vulva-vagina complex, or a ritual receptacle whose exact geometry remains unknown.

topa_cross_corpus_bridge.old_kingdom_anchor: PT 685 pairs ḥnn of Shu with kꜣ.t of Tefnut; lexical antiquity control only, not retention mechanics.
topa_cross_corpus_bridge.pJumilhac: ḥnn + mḥ + kꜣ.t + withdrawal-impossibility forms a direct biological/mythological retention script.
topa_cross_corpus_bridge.pBrooklyn_Mendes: metal kꜣ.t (kꜣ.t m bjꜣ) is beside Djed/phallus context; direct proximity and material identity, but no insertion verb.
topa_cross_corpus_bridge.Sebennytos_candidate: Jørgensen discusses sacred Lance of Shu + Net of Divine Mother/Tefnut and proposes, explicitly as interpretation, that the Lance could represent Shu's phallus and the Net Tefnut's vagina; he further suggests possible ritual union/hieros gamos of the objects.
layered_model: RETENTION_SCRIPT: ḥnn + mḥ + kꜣ.t + cannot withdraw
